definition_used: One or more errors in one or more experimental materials. including reagents, mixing bowls, equipment or instrumentation.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes errors in experimental materials (reagents, equipment), which directly affect the reliability of research content. This maps to research_content_reliability. The error is in methods/materials, and the process signal is journal_publisher_error as it is an error in the published record. Actor context is author because materials are typically prepared by authors.
